UKABCS Academic Membership

Connect with leading researchers, discover verified partner offers, and participate in peer-reviewed grant committees worldwide.

Academic Excellence & Open Science

What UKABCS Membership Means for Your Research

Empowering computational biologists, chemoinformaticians, and life science researchers with real infrastructure and international recognition.

The UK Organisation for Biotechnology and Computational Science (UKABCS) is a UK-registered non-profit academic society dedicated to advancing computational biology and biotechnology research. Membership provides verified access to shared cloud computing infrastructure, exclusive partner discounts on specialized bioinformatics software, and eligibility for competitive research grants and conference travel awards. Our members actively contribute to peer-review boards, shape grant funding criteria, and collaborate across international university networks.

Answers & Clarity

Frequently Asked Questions (F.A.Q)

Clear answers regarding UKABCS grant eligibility, peer-review timelines, membership requirements, and governance transparency.

Who is eligible to apply for UKABCS Capacity Building Grants?

Any principal investigator, faculty researcher, or registered postgraduate student affiliated with an accredited UK or Arab university is eligible. Cross-institutional UK-Arab collaborative proposals are given top priority.

How are grant decisions audited and reviewed?

All grant proposals undergo double-blind peer review by our Scientific Committee comprising independent UK and international university professors. Grant award decisions are published on our transparency portal.

Does UKABCS charge any membership or application fees?

UKABCS membership has annual GBP tiers for students, professional researchers, and institutions. Grant applications and peer-review opportunities are assessed independently under the published programme rules.

What is covered under the Graduation Project Grants?

Graduation Project Grants provide funding for final-year undergraduate and Master's thesis computational research, covering high-performance cloud compute credits, specialized software licenses, and APC publishing waivers.

How do partner publishing discounts work?

Active members can use the current verified offers listed in the Member Benefits Marketplace. Any limited-time or special partner offer is announced separately by UKABCS.
